title: Short bottom sheets sit at the bottom of a phone screen in the member app, not mid-screen

source.ref: Found building the Zap menu (LIVE-2425, 2026-11-19); owner authorized finishing all work overnight, coordinator asked for the shared fix.

detail:
The shared Dialog portals its overlay to <body> and copies `data-kit="members"` onto it so kit styles reach the panel. The member kit's unlayered `[data-design="frequency"] [data-kit="members"] { display:flex; flex-direction:column }` then beats the row the overlay's utilities assume: `items-end` aligns sideways and `justify-center` centres vertically, so any short `align="bottom"` sheet floated mid-screen on a phone, and a short `align="sheet"` panel stopped filling it.

DONE 2026-11-19: the panel classes now hold in both flex directions. `bottom` gets `mt-auto sm:my-auto` (pinned to the bottom edge on a phone, centred card at sm+), `sheet` gets `flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:my-auto` (fills the phone, centred card at sm+). Rendered at 390 and 1280 for bottom, sheet, center, top and drawer: bottom and sheet are fixed, center is unchanged. The Zap menu's local `mt-auto` workaround is removed. Not changed here: `top` still centres vertically in the kit (its `mt-[6vh]` sits inside a centred column) and `drawer` still opens full width; both are the same root cause and would need the overlay's direction itself fixed.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
